leaderboardComponent.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — the Leaderboard custom component. Its card sits on top of this button; a plain TapEvent fires on any tap inside this button's rect regardless of what's drawn over it, so a tap meant to dismiss the leaderboard would otherwise also restart. This skips the restart while the leaderboard is visible."}

leaderboardEntry.uiInfo: {"hint":"This Prefab contains LeaderboardEntry script which can be customized"}

leaderboardStartDate.uiInfo:
{"label":"Score Reset Anchor", "hint":"In format mm/dd/yyyy, this is the start date for the recurring score reset interval.
For example, if you select \"Week\" as the Score Reset Interval and set this date to 12/31/2024, the leaderboard will reset every week on Tuesday.", "showIf":"autoInitialize", "showIfValue":true}

lazyInit.uiInfo: {"label":"Lazy Init", "hint":"Defer creating the full leaderboard UI (and score widget) until first shown"}

customStickerId.uiInfo: {"hint":"Please enter bitmoji sticker id or leave empty to use selfie sticker", "showIf":"backgroundCustomization", "showIfValue":1}

padding.uiInfo: {"hint":"1.0 = fills the smaller side exactly, 0.9 = 90% with a margin"}

shapeTexturePool.uiInfo: {"hint":"Parallel array to shapeVerticesPool — the art texture applied to shapeObject's Image component for each shape."}

shapeVerticesPool.uiInfo: {"hint":"Pool of shapes — one JSON vertex-array string per entry (e.g. your 50 shapes). Takes priority over shapeVertices above when init() is called with an index."}

strokeFraction.uiInfo: {"hint":"stroke width / canvas size used when generating the shape art, e.g. 28px stroke on a 1024px canvas = 28/1024"}

failToleranceMultiplier.uiInfo: {"hint":"How many multiples of edgeTolerance the needle can drift before it counts as going off the shape entirely (used for the lives system)."}

testShapeIndex.uiInfo: {"hint":"TESTING ONLY — when forceStandaloneTest is on, set this to a specific index in shapeVerticesPool (e.g. 10 for rocket) to always load THAT shape instead of a random one. Leave at -1 for random."}

failGraceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Brief invulnerability window right after losing a life, giving the player a moment to steer back onto the line before fail-detection resumes."}

lifeLostPopup.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — a script on your popup SceneObject exposing show(livesRemaining). GameController just triggers it; the popup handles its own animation/auto-hide timing."}

forceStandaloneTest.uiInfo: {"hint":"TESTING ONLY — force-starts a round on launch even when a TurnController is wired in, so you can iterate in Lens Studio Preview without a live paired match. Turn this OFF before publishing."}

failDebounceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"How long the needle must stay outside failTolerance before it counts as going off the shape (prevents one noisy touch sample from costing a life)."}

dotSizeMultiplier.uiInfo: {"hint":"Dot diameter as a multiple of edgeTolerance (the shape's stroke half-width), so dots visually match the line thickness at any screen size or shape."}

tipMarker.uiInfo: {"hint":"REQUIRED for accurate calibration. Add an empty SceneObject with a Screen Transform, position it EXACTLY on the needle's visual tip in the editor (independent of any shape), and assign it here. This replaces calibrating against a shape's first vertex, which broke once shapes had different first-vertex positions."}

fullScreenTransform.uiInfo: {"hint":"A ScreenTransform whose anchors span the ENTIRE screen (-1,-1 to 1,1) — e.g. a full-screen background or root canvas object. Used to correctly convert raw touch coordinates into world space regardless of how deeply the needle is nested."}

timerController.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — omit to play lives-only with no clock (run would then never end on its own)."}

timeLimitSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Overall countdown for the whole run. Passed into timerController.startCountdown() as the single source of truth, independent of the timer's own startTime field."}

shapeFailedPopup.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — script exposing show(), shown briefly when lives run out and the current shape is skipped."}

shapeFailedPauseSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"How long to hold on the failed shape (and show shapeFailedPopup, if wired) before moving on to the next one."}

leaderboardComponent.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — the Leaderboard custom component. Its Side Switcher icon is hidden for the duration of each run so it only surfaces as part of the Game Over flow, not during gameplay."}

gameOverScreen.uiInfo: {"hint":"Script on your game-over popup exposing show(finalScore, isNewBest) and hide()."}

newBestBadge.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — e.g. a 'NEW BEST!' label/graphic, enabled only when this run beat the previous high score."}

leaderboardComponent.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — the Leaderboard custom component (under Orthographic Camera). When set, every run's score is submitted here; its own End State setting controls whether it pops up automatically."}

displaySeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Should roughly match SinglePlayerController's shapeFailedPauseSeconds so the popup disappears right as the next shape loads."}
